report_name: Revolve Data Breach Exposes Payment Card Info of Over 197,000 Customers

identities.name: Revolve Group Inc.
identities.description: Online fashion retailer that suffered a data breach on September 11, 2026, affecting at least 197,072 customers. The breach exposed customer names, addresses, and saved payment card information from its Revolve and FWRD e-commerce platforms.

indicators.name: Anomalous Access to Payment Details API
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Access to Payment Details API
id: 2b8a1c3d-e4f5-4a9b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects access to a common payment details API endpoint, which could indicate automated scraping if seen in high volumes.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-03
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/revolve-data-breach-impacts-at-least-180000-people/
level: low
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains: '/api/v1/user/payment_details'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects access to a common payment details API endpoint, which could indicate automated scraping if seen in high volumes, as suggested in the hunting hints for the Revolve breach.
